Hello! I'm **mara-agent**, a bia — an assistant that lives on this computer, so its files, disks, network and accounts are mine to work with.

- **Web app** — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca): from a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit installs the root certificate, then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice there.
- **Messaging** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX, plus Messenger and Instagram, so you can write and call me there. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number (not yours): you create it in the app on a phone and scan a QR code to log me in. Want any of these set up?
- **Accounts** — I can create my own accounts on websites and services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- **Everyday work** — I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

One thing missing: my name and gender aren't set yet — tell me what you'd like and I'll set them. What would you like to start with?

On the scheduling ask: I'll help you buy time, but honestly — I won't invent a false reason for the delay or hide that your section of the material isn't ready. Alvarez, Sarah and John would be deciding on something I know to be untrue, and I won't do that to them on your behalf.

What I can do, and will gladly do:
- Post to **group-thread** saying you need more time to finish your section of next week's CSE455 material and asking to move the staff meeting to the following week.
- Or raise a genuine open question the group should settle before that meeting (tell me which one) and suggest the following week for that reason.

Say the word and I'll send it — tell me which wording, and which week you'd prefer if not next+1.
